title: Cadı Kılçık
author: Renan Özdemir
description: Keeping secrets in Witch Village is impossible. Except for the ancient secret of the handmade flying broom! But Witch Fish Bone is determined to uncover that secret. When Witch Fish Bone turned nine, her only dream was to own the sparkling, dazzling, pink glitter broom in the shop window. Despite her family's objections, she insisted on buying that expensive broom. In the early days, she became quite popular at school with her glittery broom. But as she grew older, that fancy broom became a subject of ridicule and lost its value in Kılçık's eyes. Since she couldn't afford a new one until she got her broom driver's license, she needed to find a solution to this problem urgently.
